edits.new:
_buildAccountMenu(
                              context, ref, theme,
                              textColor: topbarTextColor,
                              iconColor: topbarIconColor,
                              preferredFamily: settings.theme.fontFamily,
                              preferredScale: settings.theme.fontScale,
                              compact: isHandheld,
                              mobile: isHandheld,
                            ),

required String preferredFamily,
    required double preferredScale,

family: preferredFamily,
                          scale: preferredScale,
                          dense: false,

family: preferredFamily,
                          scale: preferredScale,
                          dense: true,

style: PrimeShellMetrics.accountSignOutTextStyle(
                      theme,
                      textColor,
                      family: preferredFamily,
                      scale: preferredScale,

fontFamily: _accountFontFamily(family),
    fontSize: 13 * scale,
    fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
    letterSpacing: 0,
    height: 1,

fontFamily: _accountFontFamily(family),
    fontSize: 13 * scale,
    fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
    letterSpacing: 0,
    height: 1.5,

static String _accountFontFamily(String family) =>
      family == 'system' ? PrimeThemeCenterStyle.fontFamily : family;
